Action.name: FISSAL_TOGGLE_CONSOLE
Action.Down: if FissalRelay and FissalRelay.ToggleConsole then FissalRelay:ToggleConsole() end

Action.name: FISSAL_SWEEP_KIOSKS
Action.Down: if FissalRelay and FissalRelay.StartKioskSweep then FissalRelay:StartKioskSweep() end

Action.name: FISSAL_TOGGLE_HUD
Action.Down: if FissalRelay and FissalRelay.ToggleHUD then FissalRelay:ToggleHUD() end

Action.name: FISSAL_START_BUMP
Action.Down: if FissalRelay and FissalRelay.StartBump then FissalRelay:StartBump() end
